p.en: Control location determines what must be trusted. For a tool agent reading an untrusted webpage, protection can act on the content entering the model or constrain the operations that follow. Mechanisms that constrain execution rely on task specifications, provenance labels and policies, making the reliability of these inputs a condition of effective protection.
p.zh: 控制位置决定什么必须被信任。对于读取不可信网页的工具型 Agent，保护可以作用于进入模型的内容，也可以约束随后的操作。约束执行的机制依赖任务说明、来源标签和策略，因此这些输入的可靠性成为保护有效的条件。

p.en: Trusted task specifications receive little direct testing: three of the 40 system-level defences relying on task specifications have a recorded experiment targeting that input; two let the attacker supply the user request. Policy ablations test a different part of protection: among the 21 defences with targeted policy evaluations, 18 change or remove the policy and three examine forgery, tampering or incorrect generation.

p.en: A shared benchmark supports different safety claims. Across the 42 AgentDojo papers in the full-text sample, experiments range from detecting malicious content in replayed traces to attacking agents during online interaction. Reading these results together requires linking each reported score to the interaction, attack and stage of protection that produced it. Attacker adaptation and configuration and utility further delimit a protection claim (Table 13).
p.zh: 同一个基准支持不同的安全结论。全文样本中的 42 篇 AgentDojo 论文，实验从在回放轨迹中检测恶意内容，到在线交互中攻击 Agent，各不相同。把这些结果放在一起读，需要把每个分数对应到产生它的交互、攻击和保护阶段。攻击者的自适应以及配置与效用进一步限定了保护结论的适用范围（表 13）。

p.en: Earlier research continues to shape new hotspots through the methods and resources used to evaluate them. Following these contributions into new systems reveals how protection depends on task representations, trusted policies, attacker behaviour and implementation choices.
p.zh: 早期研究通过评测所用的方法和资源，持续影响新的热点。追踪这些成果进入新系统的过程，可以看到保护如何依赖任务表示、可信策略、攻击者行为和实现选择。
